name: Secret Society grants Shadow crit, Shadow damage and expertise (#2200)
contract: Secret Society 680611 (rank 1) and 680514 (rank 2), installed Spell.dbc, are passive family-21 spells with three effects: effect 0 SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_CRIT_CHANCE (350, misc 32 = Shadow) base 3/7 die 1 -> 4/8, effect 1 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE (79, misc 32) base 3/7 die 1 -> 4/8, effect 2 SPELL_AURA_MOD_EXPERTISE (240) base 4/9 die 1 -> 5/10; the text reads 'Shadow critical strike chance and Shadow damage dealt by 4%/8% and expertise by 5/10'. The scenario compares each talent holder against an identical talentless control (same race, class, level, no gear) so every other term cancels. Crit chance is read with the native per-spell query for Chains of Darkness' damage helper 680522 (Shadow, magic class, direct SCHOOL_DAMAGE on effect 1) because aura 350 is applied at roll time (Unit::SpellDoneCritChance), not written into the player's crit field. Damage uses the native outgoing-damage query on the same spell effect from a fixed 1000 base, where aura 79 is a plain multiplier. Torchlight 503662 is a Fire spell and is the negative control: its crit chance must not move.
